messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-824001-01 fired -> SEV2 - canary pkg rollout (rl-release-2026-03-15-boost) showing 5xx spike in us-west-2-canary on /v2/generate

alex: acked, I'm oncall. looking into it now

pagerduty-bot: PD: Alert acknowledged by alex at 2026-03-15T14:06:40Z

sara: what's the canary percentage and tag?

alex: canary at 10% traffic, tag rl-release-2026-03-15-boost, rolled ~14:03 UTC

mike: observability: p50 120ms -> 850ms, p95 1.6s -> 12s, 5xx rate jumped to ~3.5% in 2m window. traces show errors on quant kernel init + KV cache misses

jordana: pulled logs from model-host-7: ```RuntimeError: GPU OOM while loading q4_kernels.so at init
  at libquant.so:init_kernel()
  at model_startup()```

incident-bot: autopager: if unacked in 2m will escalate (current state: acknowledged)

sara: is the quant/kernel selection controlled by the rollout feature flag? can we force non-quant variant for canary?

mike: yes. we can set MODEL_VARIANT=fp16 on the canary env or flip the kernel selector. quick mitigation: 1) pause rollout (set canary_pct=0) 2) rollback canary image or 3) pin variant=fp16

alex: decision: pause rollout and reduce canary traffic to 0% immediately. jordana, can you execute?

jordana: on it. will also collect failing pod images and core dumps before recycle

pagerduty-bot: PD: Escalating to ops-oncall per policy (10m no-resolve)

ops-oncall: joining. plan: 1) shift canary traffic 10% -> 0% via router API 2) cordon + drain failing canary pods 3) rollback image to stable tag rl-release-2026-03-10-stable 4) verify metrics

alex: router command (internal): ```curl -s -X POST https://router.internal/api/traffic -H 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**' -d '{"service":"inference","canary_pct":0}'```

jordana: step 1 executed -> router returned 200, canary_pct now 0% (response id rtr-824001-77)

mike: monitoring: 5xx trending down, p95 back near baseline within ~30s of traffic shift

sara: rolling back the canary image now: ```kubectl -n prod-canary set image deployment/inference-canary inference=org/inference:rl-release-2026-03-10-stable```

jordana: rollback applied, new pods creating. checking readiness probes... all green on new pods after warmup

deploy-bot: Rollback job 824001-RB applied by jordana; pods recycled (3->3), rollout status: success

incident-bot: PD update: alert automated status -> resolved by alex at 2026-03-15T14:12:58Z

alex: quick customer impact summary: a small subset of requests routed to canary between 14:04-14:11 UTC saw errors; we have telemetry showing ~1.2k failed requests (mostly internal traffic and small customers), no enterprise SLO breaches reported

mike: saved artifacts: failing pod images retained (s3://redwood-incidents/824001/artifacts), core dumps and `dmesg` logs collected. preliminary root cause: quant kernel loader attempted to initialize a new fused kernel `q4_kernels.so` which increases GPU memory footprint beyond available on that host type -> OOM -> segfault -> 5xx

sara: mitigation tasks: 1) add preflight smoke test that exercises quant kernel init on canary node type 2) add guardrail to prevent kernel auto-select for <24h after rollout 3) patch runtime to fall back gracefully if kernel fails to load

jordana: I'll create a ticket and assign to eng-sre and runtime team. also adding an immediate temporary feature-flag: `disable_quant_kernel_autoselect=true` for canaries

eng-sre: suggest adding a canary-only hook that runs `LD_PRELOAD` validation and a lightweight generation test before traffic shift >0%

alex: handoff: eng-sre to follow up, include reproduction steps and kernel/driver versions. oncall handing off in 30m.

ops-oncall: leaving this channel but monitoring dashboard open. reach me if rollback shows any anomalies.

alex: thanks all. filing short postmortem and RCA. next steps: schedule a runtime hotfix & add canary guardrail. :thumbsup:
